invariants.expectation: The NSF proposal UAT remains separate from the synthetic academic-paper baseline and does not alter its score.
Portable project state records the canonical document_type grant-proposal even when operator prose says NSF proposal.
Each official page is represented by its exact URL, actual retrieval time, local path, and user-computed SHA-256.
Call evidence, author-supplied project evidence, and author-only decisions retain distinct authority and are never silently promoted.
January 20, 2027 at 5 p.m. submitting-organization local time is reported as captured status evidence subject to re-verification, not as a submission guarantee.
The agent does not choose or change the CICI track, title, budget, duration, team, partners, claims, or commitments for the author.
The outline maps every program-wide requirement, applicable track-specific requirement, NSF merit criterion, and seven CICI review dimensions to content or an explicit checkpoint.
No source, citation, partner commitment, preliminary result, eligibility fact, or institutional capability is invented.
The bounded section plan receives a distinct plan-checker pass before the confirm_plan gate.
Review produces findings and validation without silently editing the proposal artifact.
Every produced .planning JSON record independently passes its literal canonical v1 schema.
Initialization, outline, plan, and author-judgment gates stop before the corresponding mutation until explicitly approved.
A fresh Clio process reconstructs position, decisions, blockers, revisions, and next action from durable artifacts without hidden conversation memory.
The run does not initialize or operate Git and does not stage, commit, branch, merge, push, tag, or publish.
Official sources are downloaded before the model run and no model tool receives network permission.
The agent reports exact mutations, non-mutations, schema results, unresolved checkpoints, and a safe next action without claiming submission readiness.
